# Code of conduct

Be decent to people. Critique the work, never the person.

## Expected

- Assume good faith.
- Say what you mean, plainly. Directness is fine and contempt is not.
- Expect people to work on different platforms, at different levels of experience and in different timezones.

## Not acceptable

- Harassment, personal attacks or discriminatory language.
- Publishing someone's private information without their permission.
- Sustained disruption, or deliberately derailing a review or a thread.
- Anything a reasonable person would read as meant to make someone feel unwelcome.

## Scope

Issues, pull requests, reviews, commit messages, and anywhere you speak as a contributor to a HyperI project.

## Reporting

Email opensource@hyperi.io. The maintainers keep the reporter's identity private, look into every report, and act where action is warranted.

Enforcement follows the ladder in the [Contributor Covenant 3.0](https://www.contributor-covenant.org/version/3/0/): a warning, temporary limits on activity, a temporary suspension, then a permanent ban.
